description: How popular has a first name been in the US? Yearly counts and ranks of babies given the name since 1880 (US Social Security data), its peak year and best rank. Use for "how popular was Olivia in 1990" or "when did Jayden peak". More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

name.description: A first name as SSA spells it: 2-15 letters A-Z, any case ("olivia" works). Spaces, hyphens and apostrophes are dropped like SSA drops them ("Mary-Kate" → "Marykate"). Accents are read as plain letters ("Sofía" finds "Sofia").

sex.description: F or M, as recorded by SSA. Leave out for both.

to.description: Last year of the series (default: the latest year).

name: baby_name_history
title: A baby name's popularity since 1880
